maria: Drafting a short docs PR for private bootstrap that focuses on proxy + airgapped KMS examples. Need quick review before I open the PR.

sam: Paste the minimal curl/node/python samples here and I'll eyeball TLS caveats.

maria: curl (debug/local):
```bash
curl -X POST https://redwood-local:8443/v1/ping \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  --proxy http://proxy.internal:3128 \
  --cacert /etc/ssl/certs/custom-ca.pem
```
Python (requests):
```py
import os, requests
os.environ['REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE'] = '/etc/ssl/certs/custom-ca.pem'
resp = requests.post('https://redwood-local:8443/v1/ping', headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer <TOKEN>'}, proxies={'https': 'http://proxy.internal:3128'}, timeout=8)
print(resp.status_code)
```
Node (fetch):
```js
const https = require('https');
const fs = require('fs');
const agent = new https.Agent({ ca: fs.readFileSync('/etc/ssl/certs/custom-ca.pem') });
await fetch('https://redwood-local:8443/v1/ping', { method: 'POST', headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer '+process.env.TOKEN }, agent });
```

jin: Add note: some corporate proxies terminate TLS. For debug mention `--proxy-insecure` or `--insecure` but warn against using in prod. Also call out REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE or verify param.

maria: Will add. Also adding runtime requirements: allow egress TCP/9000 to kms.internal and TCP/443 to control plane. HSM plugin requires /var/lib/redwood/hsm mounted with owner root:redwood and mode 0750.

ops: HSM SELinux heads-up: add chcon example and systemd bind-mount hint. Example: `chcon -R -t container_file_t /var/lib/redwood/hsm` and installer should create the bind mount before service start.

sam: Small nit: our infra moved the port matrix. Replace old link with https://docs.redwood.ai/infra/port-matrix-2026.
